folded.object: those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace

spans.text: Show us the straight way, The way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, those whose (portion) is not wrath, and who go not astray.
Allah hath set a seal on their hearts and on their hearing, and on their eyes is a veil; great is the penalty they (incur).
In their hearts is a disease; and Allah has increased their disease: And grievous is the penalty they (incur), because they are false (to themselves).
But give glad tidings to those who believe and work righteousness, that their portion is Gardens, beneath which rivers flow.

folded.id: their similitude|is|that of a man who kindled a fire
folded.subject: Their similitude
folded.object: that of a man who kindled a fire

spans.text: These are they who have bartered Guidance for error: But their traffic is profitless, and they have lost true direction, Their similitude is that of a man who kindled a fire; when it lighted all around him, Allah took away their light and left them in utter darkness.

folded.id: them out|of|the state (of felicity) in which they had been
folded.subject: them out
folded.object: the state (of felicity) in which they had been

spans.text: Then did Satan make them slip from the (garden), and get them out of the state (of felicity) in which they had been.
And He taught Adam the names of all things; then He placed them before the angels, and said: "Tell me the names of these if ye are right."
How can ye reject the faith in Allah?- seeing that ye were without life, and He gave you life; then will He cause you to die, and will again bring you to life; and again to Him will ye return.
We said: "Get ye down all from here; and if, as is sure, there comes to you Guidance from me, whosoever follows My guidance, on them shall be no fear, nor shall they grieve.

Adore your Guardian-Lord, who created you and those who came before you, that ye may have the chance to learn righteousness; Who has made the earth your couch, and the heavens your canopy; and sent down rain from the heavens; and brought forth therewith Fruits for your sustenance; then set not up rivals unto Allah when ye know (the truth).

By it He causes many to stray, and many He leads into the right path; but He causes not to stray, except those who forsake (the path),- Those who break Allah's Covenant after it is ratified, and who sunder what Allah Has ordered to be joined, and do mischief on earth: These cause loss (only) to themselves.

Every time they are fed with fruits therefrom, they say: "Why, this is what we were fed with before," for they are given things in similitude; and they have therein companions pure (and holy); and they abide therein (for ever).
Nay, of a surety they are the fools, but they do not know.
Of a surety, they are the ones who make mischief, but they realise (it) not.

Nay, seek (Allah's) help with patient perseverance and prayer: It is indeed hard, except to those who bring a lowly spirit,- Who bear in mind the certainty that they are to meet their Lord, and that they are to return to Him.

Every time they are fed with fruits therefrom, they say: "Why, this is what we were fed with before," for they are given things in similitude; and they have therein companions pure (and holy); and they abide therein (for ever).
As to those who reject Faith, it is the same to them whether thou warn them or do not warn them; they will not believe.
Deaf, dumb, and blind, they will not return (to the path).

This is the Book; in it is guidance sure, without doubt, to those who fear Allah; Who believe in the Unseen, are steadfast in prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them; And who believe in the Revelation sent to thee, and sent before thy time, and (in their hearts) have the assurance of the Hereafter.

folded.object: what we were fed with before

folded.id: thou hast|taught|us: in truth it is thou who art perfect in knowledge and wisdom
folded.subject: Thou Hast
folded.object: us: In truth it is Thou Who art perfect in knowledge and wisdom

spans.text: They said: "Glory to Thee, of knowledge We have none, save what Thou Hast taught us: In truth it is Thou Who art perfect in knowledge and wisdom."

folded.subject: thy Lord
folded.object: to the angels: "I will create a vicegerent on earth

spans.text: Behold, thy Lord said to the angels: "I will create a vicegerent on earth."

Adore your Guardian-Lord, who created you and those who came before you, that ye may have the chance to learn righteousness; Who has made the earth your couch, and the heavens your canopy; and sent down rain from the heavens; and brought forth therewith Fruits for your sustenance; then set not up rivals unto Allah when ye know (the truth).

folded.subject: We said
folded.object: the angels: "Bow down to Adam" and they bowed down

spans.text: And behold, We said to the angels: "Bow down to Adam" and they bowed down.

By it He causes many to stray, and many He leads into the right path; but He causes not to stray, except those who forsake (the path),- Those who break Allah's Covenant after it is ratified, and who sunder what Allah Has ordered to be joined, and do mischief on earth: These cause loss (only) to themselves.

folded.id: when it|is|said to them: "make not mischief on the earth
folded.subject: When it
folded.object: said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth

spans.text: When it is said to them: "Make not mischief on the earth," they say: "Why, we only Want to make peace!"
When it is said to them: "Believe as the others believe:" They say: "Shall we believe as the fools believe?"

folded.id: which|is|prepared for those who reject faith
folded.subject: which
folded.object: prepared for those who reject Faith

spans.text: But if ye cannot- and of a surety ye cannot- then fear the Fire whose fuel is men and stones,- which is prepared for those who reject Faith.

Adore your Guardian-Lord, who created you and those who came before you, that ye may have the chance to learn righteousness; Who has made the earth your couch, and the heavens your canopy; and sent down rain from the heavens; and brought forth therewith Fruits for your sustenance; then set not up rivals unto Allah when ye know (the truth).

folded.id: wilt thou|place|therein one who will make mischief therein and shed blood?- whilst we do celebrate thy praises and glorify thy holy (name)?"
folded.subject: Wilt Thou
folded.object: therein one who will make mischief therein and shed blood?- whilst we do celebrate Thy praises and glorify Thy holy (name)?"

spans.text: They said: "Wilt Thou place therein one who will make mischief therein and shed blood?- whilst we do celebrate Thy praises and glorify Thy holy (name)?"

folded.id: ye reject|the|faith in allah?- seeing that ye were without life
folded.subject: ye reject
folded.object: faith in Allah?- seeing that ye were without life

spans.text: How can ye reject the faith in Allah?- seeing that ye were without life, and He gave you life; then will He cause you to die, and will again bring you to life; and again to Him will ye return.
When he had told them, Allah said: "Did I not tell you that I know the secrets of heaven and earth, and I know what ye reveal and what ye conceal?"
Do ye enjoin right conduct on the people, and forget (To practise it) yourselves, and yet ye study the Scripture?

folded.id: your covenant|with|me as i fulfil my covenant with you
folded.subject: your covenant
folded.object: Me as I fulfil My Covenant with you

spans.text: call to mind the (special) favour which I bestowed upon you, and fulfil your covenant with Me as I fulfil My Covenant with you, and fear none but Me.

folded.id: your heads|with|those who bow down (in worship)
folded.subject: your heads

spans.text: And be steadfast in prayer; practise regular charity; and bow down your heads with those who bow down (in worship).
